additional_kwargs.reasoning_content: We need average duration_ms per mcp_server for calls before Oct 28 2026. Use tool_calls table. Filter called_at < '2026-10-28'. Group by mcp_server. Compute avg(duration_ms).

function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT mcp_server, AVG(duration_ms)::numeric AS avg_duration_ms
FROM tool_calls
WHERE called_at < '2026-10-28'::date
GROUP BY mcp_server
ORDER BY mcp_server;"}
function.name: query_database

args.sql:
SELECT mcp_server, AVG(duration_ms)::numeric AS avg_duration_ms
FROM tool_calls
WHERE called_at < '2026-10-28'::date
GROUP BY mcp_server
ORDER BY mcp_server;
